goal: Native Quest application for a wireless Mac desktop attached to a chosen physical wall

requirements.primarySelection: headset volume button; exact rocker direction not yet established
requirements.candidatePreview: dashed outlines aligned with mapped flat surfaces
requirements.placement: fit the whole panel within a valid flat area; reject obstructed positions
requirements.occlusion: real foreground objects must occlude virtual UI
requirements.transportPreference: reuse the existing Sunshine/Moonlight television technology
requirements.microphoneLater: headset microphone with held selection key, routed to Mac dictation/Wispr Flow

validated.browserPrototype: live Mac desktop confirmed by user; temporary proof, not the final application
validated.prototypeTransport: authenticated TLS Air-to-Mini; WebSocket through wireless ADB reverse to Quest browser
validated.latency: user reports approximately 5–10 seconds; unacceptable for typing; not yet isolated or corrected
validated.webxr: immersive-ar, local-floor, hand-tracking, anchors and plane-detection enabled; no planes returned
validated.nativeRuntime: properly declared manifest exposes passthrough, spatial entities/query/storage, scene/capture, environmental depth, hand tracking/aim and local-floor

constraints.noHeadsetRequiredDuringBuild: ask user to wear headset only for specific spatial/input/visual tests
